title: Effect of Simvastatin on Bone Regeneration: A Histologic and Histomorphometric Analysis*
authors: Yaghobee S, Pa njnoush M, Chokami Rafiei S, Amini Shakib P, Mahmoodi S, Rasouli -Ghahroudi AAR, Poursafar F. J Oral Maxillofac Surg. 2020 Jun;78(6):927-934. doi: 10.1016/j.joms.2020.01.016.
supports: Clinical study from the botiss cerabone (sintered bovine bone) literature list — the product featured in it, which is not the same as the study being about the product, so check the design and the comparator before citing it as product evidence. Authors' conclusion, verbatim: “Despite the greater mean percentage of newly formed bone in the test group, the histomorphometric analysis results did not show a significant positive effect for the use of simvastatin in maxillary sinus augmentation. *Study refers to CompactBone B., which was a private label of cerabone®” This records what the paper says, not what a rep may say: the sales wording still has to pass the claim tiers, and a study in one indication licenses nothing in another.
